name: URTC-VISION-TOOL
build: bash build_firmware.sh. Also contains an independent Python vision companion package (cd src/vision_companion && pip install -e '.[dev]' && pytest).
notes: Firmware now has a real, hardware-independent sensor protocol (sensor_frame.c: versioned framing + CRC8; sensor_reading.c: real range validation; rate_limiter.c: real minimum-interval throttling; sensor_diagnostics.c: real error/latency/bus-reset counters, kept separate from any accept/reject decision) with a real host-side sensor simulator covering valid/truncated/CRC-corrupt/out-of-range/disconnected frames - 65 host-native test assertions. Still pending a real PCB: wiring this pipeline to a real MLX9064x/RGB trigger over I2C/SPI. The Python vision_companion package is real and test-covered: synthetic thermal+RGB frame generation, false-color rendering, and real RGB->thermal ROI alignment + temperature-stats extraction (alignment.py), all verified by 21 real pytest cases. Real dual-modal (RGB + thermal) capture and per-pixel sensor calibration still need a real PCB and real cameras.
